title: Line-level accounting attributes (file kept at its v1 path; content revised for ADR-0007)
status: PROPOSAL except where a row says CONFIRMED. Values are closed sets; a new value needs a reviewed change.
principle: Attributes describe accounting and evidence facts on the journal line. They never carry a compliance choice (election, ATC selection, regime, VAT status, deduction method, rate). Measures (data/measures.v1.json) select lines by these attributes, never by account (ADR-0006, ADR-0007).
layers: account (what the transaction is; posting only)
category (a starting point for lines; suggestions may use the linked tax profile's registered-forms list as a hint)
line attributes (accounting and evidence facts, per line)
measures (accounting measures per business profile per period, with lineage)
mapping rules (measure to Forms input key, versioned; the bridge)

money.text: exactly two decimal places in JSON, for example "200000.00"; more than two decimals is refused
money.floats: not allowed in Books money paths

dates.entry_date: DATE in Asia/Manila (calendar day). It is the revenue-recognition date for measures (D4: the date policy is an accounting policy that Books keeps).
dates.recognition_date: DATE; may differ from entry date when the recognition policy says so (D4, accounting policy, open)
dates.certificate_period: period_start and period_end as DATE (BK-TS uses text: tax-certificates.ts:53-54)

line_attributes.name: measure_side
line_attributes.rule: Which side of the line is positive for its measure: credit for income and amounts withheld, debit for expenses, costs and receivables. A reversal mirrors the original, so its signed amount is the exact negative. Required when income_class or comp_component is set, or the line is a certificate.

line_attributes.name: income_class
line_attributes.rule: Which statement bucket the line feeds: sales, contra sales (returns, allowances, discounts), other non-operating income, cost of sales, operating expense. Output VAT, payables and receivables are none.

line_attributes.name: contra_kind
line_attributes.rule: Required on a contra_sales line. Returns, allowances and discounts are separate measures.

line_attributes.name: person_scope
line_attributes.rule: Whose activity the line records. self is the business owner (measure scope taxpayer). Spouse lines are measured but refused by the bridge in MVP (EXC.SPOUSE_MVP).

line_attributes.name: counterparty_kind
line_attributes.rule: What kind of party is on the line. The party is referenced by an opaque party_ref. No TIN is stored on a line.
citations: books.md s2 (parties; TIN columns are plaintext in Books)

line_attributes.name: party_ref
allowed_values: opaque id (never a TIN, never a name)
line_attributes.rule: Reference to a party record kept by Books (customer, supplier, employee, payor). Payroll lines for 13th month pay carry the employee's party_ref so the 1601-C item 17 split can be made per employee.

line_attributes.name: comp_component
line_attributes.rule: Payroll component of a payroll line, as recorded by payroll. statutory_minimum_wage is basic pay of an employee that payroll records as a minimum-wage earner. contribution is a mandatory contribution or union dues (see contribution_side and contribution_scheme). tax_withheld is the tax payroll withheld from pay (a fact; Books does not compute it).

line_attributes.name: contribution_side
line_attributes.rule: Whose share a contribution is. Employee shares and employer shares are separate measures. The employer share never feeds 1601-C item 19 (EXC.EMPLOYER_SHARE_NOT_19).

line_attributes.name: contribution_scheme
line_attributes.rule: Which scheme a contribution line belongs to. Gives the per-scheme breakdown of the contribution measures.
citations: owner correction 2026-10-29 (SSS/GSIS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, union dues)

line_attributes.name: credit_kind
line_attributes.rule: Which tax a received withholding certificate reports as withheld, as printed on the certificate (WB series = percentage tax; WI and WC series = income tax). An evidence fact; the routing to form boxes is a mapping fact (EXC.IT_CWT_NOT_PT, EXC.PT_CWT_NOT_IT).

line_attributes.name: certificate_atc
line_attributes.rule: The ATC printed on a received certificate (2307 or 2306). Evidence only: Books records what the document says. Books never selects an ATC for a return; that is Forms'.

line_attributes.name: certificate_status
line_attributes.rule: Status of a certificate. Only received certificates count in a certificate measure (GATE.CERT_STATUS).

line_attributes.name: document_kind
line_attributes.rule: Kind of evidence document. A credit_note is a return event (GATE.RETURNS_ACK). certificate_2307 is creditable withholding; certificate_2306 is final withholding and never counts in a 2307 measure.
citations: workbook Category field rules (credit note rows)

line_attributes.name: evidence_ref
line_attributes.rule: Pointer to stored evidence. The model sees the sha256 and kind only; OCR text is not sent by default (design R-23).

line_attributes.name: period_override
line_attributes.rule: Explicit override of the recognition period. An accounting policy (D4, kept with Books). The PoC uses the entry date only.
citations: decision D4 (revenue recognition: accounting policy part kept)

line_attributes.name: final_tax_withheld
line_attributes.rule: Evidence fact: whether a payor or bank withheld final tax on this income (for example interest). How it affects 1701-MS IV.13 or IV.20 is an open mapping question (EXC.FINAL_TAX_INTEREST). Not stored by BK-TS today (sheets.md s10: UNKNOWN).

forms_supplied.note: Removed from the Books line and profile model by ADR-0007. These are compliance choices or computations owned by Buwiz Forms / the BIR mini app. Where a mapping needs one of them to choose between alternative input boxes, the bridge reads it from the Forms draft or profile as form_context; it never stores or decides it.

removed_attributes.name: tax_type
removed_attributes.why: Which tax a line belongs to is decided by the forms the taxpayer must file (Forms). Measures are tax-neutral.

removed_attributes.name: atc
removed_attributes.why: ATC selection for a return is Forms'. Only the ATC printed on a received certificate is kept, as evidence (certificate_atc).

removed_attributes.name: treatment
removed_attributes.why: How a line enters a tax computation is a compliance concept. Replaced by income_class, comp_component and measure_side (accounting facts).

removed_attributes.name: regime
removed_attributes.why: 8% versus graduated is the yearly election in the Forms tax profile. Read as form_context /taxpayer/tax_option.

removed_attributes.name: vat_status
removed_attributes.why: VAT registration and the VAT threshold test are Forms'.

removed_attributes.name: election_event
removed_attributes.why: Elections are recorded in the Forms tax profile.

removed_attributes.name: deductibility
removed_attributes.why: OSD versus itemized and deductibility are Forms' (read as form_context /taxpayer/deduction).

removed_attributes.name: returns_state
removed_attributes.why: Replaced by an entry-level acknowledgement of return events (GATE.RETURNS_ACK, bookkeeping review).

removed_attributes.name: sign_and_rounding
removed_attributes.why: Rounding of tax amounts is Forms'. Measures are exact centavos and never rounded.

removed_attributes.name: tax_period_key
removed_attributes.why: Renamed period_override; it is an accounting recognition override, not a tax period.

credit_note_line.description: Synthetic sales return against a Q3 sale

forbidden_in_books: BIR tickets (tkt_...) or Rox tokens in records
account-implied meaning (a measure never selects by account number or subtype)
compliance choices on a line or profile: regime, election, VAT status, ATC selection, deduction method
rates, thresholds, due dates, penalties, tax rounding
